research_summary: Researched Vasco Rossi (id=96) for the Demotape project. Vasco Rossi is not a traditional band but a solo Italian singer-songwriter (cantautore) born 7 February 1952 in Zocca (Modena), Emilia-Romagna. He has a 50+ year career spanning 30+ albums and 250+ songs. His connection to RockGalileo (id=86) is through Saverio Lanza (RockGalileo frontman) who became a producer/arranger and collaborated with Vasco Rossi post-1998, co-writing 'Benvenuti nel vostro viaggio'. Vasco Rossi's early career was in the Bologna underground scene (1970s), co-founding Punto Radio and releasing on indie labels (Lotus, Targa Italiana) before achieving massive commercial success with Carosello Records and later Universal Music Italy. The database was updated with full bio, discography (16 releases from 1978-2021), external links (7), genre tags, Discogs/MusicBrainz IDs, and a scene_peer connection to RockGalileo.
